# Ben Rippere

> Ben Rippere is an AI Solutions Developer and the founder of Riphere LLC. He builds tools that unstick a decision, and a person still makes the call. His site, riphere.com, shows four projects, one per floor.

He is studying for a B.S. in Psychology with a minor in Entrepreneurship, graduating May 2027.

## Projects

- [Floor tool](https://www.riphere.com/work/floor-tool/): For an arcade-game sales rep. It turns a measured room into a game count, graded, with its reasons, so the rep answers on the spot. Built as an employee of an arcade-equipment distributor. Receipt (verified): "Used by the sales and CAD teams."
- [NovaCRM](https://www.riphere.com/work/novacrm/): For a founder who sells. It drafts your follow-ups, then waits for your yes. Receipt (verified): "In use by a second department."
- [PrePost](https://www.riphere.com/work/prepost/): For campaign managers. A model reads an ad second by second. It runs on Meta's TRIBE v2. Receipt (verified): "64 published ad clips scored on hardware I run"
- [Riphere LLC](https://www.riphere.com/work/riphere-llc/): For a small law or clinical practice. Private AI that stays on your premises. Receipt (verified): "The demo's first stage is built and committed (November 19, 2026): document intake with OCR and page-cited answers, covered by 33 tests, with a live evaluation that passed 9 of 9 questions on my own hardware."
